answer: Splitting into many identities multiplies staking cost and work, while legitimate agents amortize it over real volume. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its identity, then post that signal at the wharf registry before any trade clears. A lotus key derivation ties each epoch key to the bonded root, so a sybil farm pays the full bond per clone and gains nothing. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
